The structure of Lu2Ge4N6 (reduced formula LuGe2N3) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ge centers with a tetrahedral environment of four N neighbors, while N centers adopt a three-Ge geometry and Lu centers are coordinated by ten neighbors (six Ge, four N). The polyhedral network includes corner-sharing between Ge tetrahedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between Ge tetrahedra and Lu 10-vertex coordination polyhedra. These are geometry-derived results from CrystalNN, not chemical bonds.
